title: The v1 Gödel-Cohen independence claim is not sourced here
summary: Independence of the continuum hypothesis from ZFC is a standard theorem we did not re-read.
body: The v1 infinity article says the continuum hypothesis was proved undecidable by Gödel and Cohen. That result, carefully stated, is independence from the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms with choice: Gödel on the consistency of CH, Cohen on the consistency of its negation. Their papers were not opened. Koellner calls the problem open, which is a different emphasis. Leave the names-and-proof claim unsourced until the papers or a theorem statement we have read are attached.
